component.name: NowCaption
component.summary: Live captions for anything your computer plays

description.p: NowCaption shows live captions for videos, calls, streams and games, or for your microphone. It is made for people who are deaf or hard of hearing, and for anyone who wants to read what is being said.
Speech is recognised on your own computer. Audio never leaves it, no account is needed, and it works offline.

ul.li: Accurate English recognition with punctuation and capital letters
Words appear about half a second after they are spoken
Light on the processor and uses nothing while it is quiet
Stays above other windows on KDE Plasma, Hyprland and Sway
Adjustable text size and background, and transcript copy and save

description.p: Right-click the captions for settings. Drag them to move them.
